original_target.title: Dirichlet spectral determination of smooth strictly convex planar domains

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Target concerns complete Dirichlet spectra of arbitrary smooth strictly convex planar domains. Hu–Shi–Tang current Theorem1.1.2 gives strictly convex analytic isospectral pairs for Steklov, not Dirichlet. No implication across boundary conditions; local ellipse or symmetric rigidity still restricts domain classes. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
